'''Rod Latham Tatooine Speeder Deck''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/bb3.htm Tatooine Speeder Deck], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031210164653/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/bb3.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
